business_scope.primary_industry_name: Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Certification and Security Auditing

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y la financiación del terrorismo (as amended by Law 7/2021 and Royal Decree 1008/2022 regulating the UBO register)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by possible Apostille if foreign

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening for Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) using Guardia Civil, Europol, and international lists; OFAC SDN, UN, EU sanctions lists; domestic AML/CFT compliance protocols per Ley 10/2010

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Spanish language using Latin alphabet; names must comply with Spanish orthographic rules and cannot include prohibited terms without authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Rejection of name reservation may be appealed administratively to the Registro Mercantil Central within 1 month; further judicial appeal possible if needed

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are permissible for registered office purposes in Spain for SL entities, provided they offer a physical address and are not purely mail services; accepted by notaries and the Registro Mercantil
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low likelihood of unannounced physical inspections for standard SL formations; higher in regulated industries like AEO certification requiring additional compliance audits

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notary public fees for incorporation documents
Registro Mercantil name reservation and filing fees
Professional legal due diligence and name clearance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hourly billing at 150-200 EUR/hour or fixed project fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT compliance screening and PEP checks
Registered office setup and utility costs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Virtual office provider or utility company

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC); arts. 19-23 (constitución), art. 22 (minimum capital of S.L.: EUR 3,000), arts. 32-34 (by-laws), arts. 36-44 (founders and public deed), art. 58 (registration in the Mercantile Registry); complementary fast-incorporation rules of Ley 14/2013 de apoyo a emprendedores.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (name certificate) and Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province of the registered office (inscription); notarial function exercised by Spanish Notaries (Colegio Notarial).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura pública de constitución (public deed of incorporation) and its obligatory inscription in the Registro Mercantil; NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) application on Form 036.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: EUR 3,000 minimum share capital, fully subscribed and fully paid up at execution of the deed; cash contributions evidenced to the Notary, typically by the bank's certificate of deposit (certificado de depósito); funds may remain blocked until inscription; no mandatory escrow account exists under Spanish law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME], S.L. The Director, acting under the by-laws in the public deed executed before a Spanish Notary on [DATE], RESOLVES: 1. To approve the subscription and full payment of the EUR 3,000 share capital, evidenced by bank certificate of deposit. 2. To adopt [registered office address] as the registered office, fiscal domicile and seat of management. 3. To ratify the appointment of [Name] as Director and [Name] as Secretary. 4. To execute the constitutive deed, pay incorporation expenses and file the company records with the Mercantile Registry. 5. To obtain the provisional and definitive NIF, register with Social Security and open bank accounts. 6. To grant the Director powers to implement these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reservation of Corporate Name (Certificado Negativo de Denominación Social)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry), Madrid — online name certificate service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an electronic application to the Registro Mercantil Central requesting certification that the proposed name '[NAME], S.L.' is not held by any existing Spanish company; pay the official arancel; obtain the negative name certificate and deliver it to the Notary with the draft deed.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name with three alternative orderings
Applicant identification (DNI/NIE/passport copy)
Registro Mercantil Central application form and receipt of official fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or already recorded, file the alternatives in order of preference or modify the denomination; if the two-month validity expires, obtain a renewing certificate before execution of the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining the Provisional Tax Number (NIF Provisional)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), provincial Delegación corresponding to the future fiscal domicile
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 036 for issuance of the provisional company NIF before notarization, submitting the identification of the incorporators and the intended registered office; the provisional NIF must be recited in the public deed and is later replaced by the definitive NIF upon inscription.
required_dossiers: Form 036 signed by the promoter or applicant
Certificado negativo de denominación social
Copies of DNI/NIE or passports of incorporators and of the designated director
Proof of intended fiscal domicile
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEAT returns the Form 036 with query, correct the missing boxes and resubmit electronically; a provisional NIF may also be granted immediately when the filing is made before the competent office with complete documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Provisional Bank Account and Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any Spanish credit institution or cooperative subject to Banco de España supervision
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional corporate account in the name of the future S.L., deposit at least EUR 3,000, and ask the bank for a certificate of deposit (certificado de depósito) naming the future company and evidencing the blocked funds; the certificate is delivered to the Notary at the deed execution.
required_dossiers: Draft by-laws (estatutos) of the S.L.
Provisional NIF
Identity documents of shareholders and directors
Bank anti-money-laundering forms and record of beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a discrepancy in the company name or capital amount, require the bank to issue a corrected certificate; if the account is not opened, complete the bank's due-diligence questionnaire and resubmit the formation package.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Notary Public (Notario) of the notarial district where the registered office is located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the Notary with the draft by-laws, negative name certificate, provisional NIF, bank fund certificate and proof of the right to use the registered office; the Notary verifies legal capacity and explains the deed; the escritura pública de constitución is signed by all incorporators and issued in first authorized copies (copia autorizada) for registry filing.
required_dossiers: Valid negative name certificate
Provisional NIF of the future company
Bank certificate of deposit for EUR 3,000
Draft by-laws signed by all incorporators
DNI/NIE or passports of all incorporators and directors
Evidence of the right to use the registered office (lease or ownership deed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary records formal objections or requires additional anti-money-laundering identification, supply the requested materials and schedule a new appointment; any defect in the first deed is remedied through an escritura de subsanación (corrective deed) before registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Mercantile Registry and Obtaining the Definitive NIF
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province of the registered office; AEAT provincial Delegación for the definitive NIF
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month (or two months if extended by the Notary) from execution, file the first authorized copy of the deed and the relevant fee receipt with the Registro Mercantil Provincial; once inscribed, request a certification of registration and submit Form 036 in definitive mode to AEAT together with the registered deed copy to convert the provisional NIF into the definitive NIF.
required_dossiers: First authorized copy of the escritura pública
Certificado negativo de denominación social annexed to the deed
Modelo 600 receipt for deed stamp tax (ITP-AJD) if payable in the relevant Autonomous Community
Form 036 for provisional and definitive NIF
Official registration fee receipt (arancel del Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a notice of suspension (defectos), cure the stated defects within the granted period by filing a corrective deed or supplementary documents; if the filing deadline cannot be met, ask the Notary for the two-month regulatory extension before the registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer Registration with Social Security and Municipal Activity Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS); local Ayuntamiento competent for the activity licence or responsible declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company as an employer with the TGSS (Form TA.6) to obtain the employer account code before hiring; file a municipal declaración responsable (or the activity licence where the local ordinance so provides) for the office premises, attaching the technical compliance certificate covering fire safety and safe office use; submit to municipal inspection if summoned.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Mercantile Registry inscription and definitive NIF
Form TA.6 (inscripción de empresa) for the TGSS
Municipal declaration of commencement of activity or licence application for the office
Technical certificate of fire protection and electrical installation of the premises
Lease or title deed proving the right of use over the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the TGSS returns the application for correction, verify the CNAE code (7020) and address data; if the Ayuntamiento issues a requerimiento, file the missing technical reports or perform the requested fire-safety remedial works and obtain the final inspector's conformity certificate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial manufacturing licence is required for the ISIC 7020 AEO audit and supply-chain compliance service; the competent bodies are the municipal urban planning/licensing department for office premises and, on an opt-in basis, the Entidad Nacional de Acreditación (ENAC) for ISO/IEC 17020 or ISO 27001 accreditation of the audit reports.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal activity clearance for office premises (declaración responsable de inicio de actividad / licencia de apertura); no environmental operating permit is applicable.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (State level) and Consejería de Medio Ambiente of the corresponding Autonomous Community (regional level)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — office-based consulting and AEO security auditing does not fall under Annexes I or II of Ley 21/2013 de evaluación ambiental, so no full EIA, AAU or abbreviated environmental assessment is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC or industrial air emission parameters apply to the activity; the office must comply with the municipal sewerage and waste ordinances, and any destroyed or confidential documents must be handled by an authorized waste manager (gestor autorizado) with a documentary trail as required for AEO security auditing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate and building occupancy/structural certificate (licencia de utilización) obtained from the local fire prevention service and municipal technical office; workplace safety clearance drawn up under Ley 31/1995 de Prevención de Riesgos Laborales, including evacuation plan, first-aid equipment and the company's risk-prevention documentation; personnel engaged in AEO audits must have clean criminal and administrative records and unescorted customs-area access clearance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), official Spanish tax authority and portal at https://www.agenciatributaria.es/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Spanish SL entities obtain NIF (TIN equivalent) upon incorporation through the Registro Mercantil Central and subsequent registration with AEAT; foreign entities must apply to AEAT with incorporation documents, power of attorney, and residency proof to secure statutory TIN/VAT ID.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections or hybrid mismatch elections available; Spain applies entity-level taxation under a unitary national regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory SII (Sistema de Información de Facturación) real-time electronic invoicing, clearance, and digital stamping via API integration for all VAT-registered entities.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate on goods exported outside the EU or offshore services supplied to non-resident clients; requires verifiable proof of export and non-EU destination.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT audits trigger penalties up to 100% of evaded VAT, retrospective clawback of zero-rated benefits, and potential criminal sanctions for fraudulent claims.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), Madrid; principal monetary, financial supervisory, and foreign-exchange statistics authority within the Eurosystem and the European Central Bank's Single Supervisory Mechanism. Foreign-investment screening and exchange-policy coordination are administered by the Ministerio de Economía, Comercio y Empresa (Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones, DGCOMEXI) and the Comisión de Inversiones Exteriores; AML/CFT supervision of the banking system is shared with SEPBLAC.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain maintains full liberalisation of both current-account and capital-account movements under Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, the OECD Code of Liberalisation of Capital Movements, and the domestic codifying statute Law 19/2003 of 4 July 2003 (Régimen Jurídico de los Movimientos de Capitales y las Transacciones Económicas con el Exterior). The euro is fully convertible, and there are no exchange controls, no surrender requirements, and no approval gates for ordinary trade payments, service fees, or dividend repatriation. Operational hurdles are administrative, not convertibility-based: (i) the temporary foreign-investment screening regime (Royal Decree-Law 8/2020, as extended) may require prior authorisation for non-EU/EFTA investors acquiring control in strategic sectors (energy, defence, telecommunications, ports, media, financial infrastructure); an ISIC 7020 AEO supply-chain audit consultancy is not a covered sector, but the bank will still verify the source of capital; (ii) distributions to non-resident shareholders are free of exchange permission but incur non-resident income tax (IRNR) withholding at 19%, reducible to 0-5% for qualifying EU/EEA corporate parents under the Parent-Subsidiary Directive; (iii) all cross-border flows above statistical thresholds must be reported to Banco de España through the monthly balance-of-payments declaration system. Profit remittance by an SL is therefore legally unconstrained; the practical burden is documentation, withholding formalities, and de-risking behaviour by banks in the onboarding phase.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Spain imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender and no mandatory conversion ratio for export or service-export receipts (0% surrender). An ISIC 7020 AEO certification and supply-chain audit firm may invoice in EUR, USD, CLP, or any mutually agreed currency and may retain foreign currency in designated divisa accounts maintained with resident credit institutions without Banco de España authorisation. The mandatory compliance obligations are: (i) statistical declaration to Banco de España (Declaración de Cobros y Pagos / BE-105 statement) when cumulative collections or payments with a non-resident counterparty exceed EUR 50,000 per calendar month, or when a cash movement exceeds EUR 10,000 (the latter simultaneously triggers the EU cash-declaration rule); (ii) documentary proof for the VAT zero-rating of export services, including the customer's foreign tax-residence certificate and the underlying service contract; (iii) full audit trail of each transaction with SWIFT bank reference codes and purpose codes (e.g., BoP code for consultancy services, code 145; for auditing and accounting services, code 861). No conversion licence or central-bank approval is required before using export proceeds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Business Operating Account (Cuenta de Operaciones en EUR) with multi-currency sub-ledgers (USD, CLP, MXN) and an optional Client Money Escrow sub-account
Cuenta Negocios — corporate transactional account with integrated FX-for-Business pre-trade module, SWIFT MT103 execution, and SEPA Instant Credit Transfer clearing
Cuenta de Empresa / Cuenta Expansión — operational EUR account with trade-finance documentation (documentary credits, guarantees) and SME cash-management tools
Sabadell Professional / Sabadell Negocios — SME current account with dedicated international desk for Latin American corridors and documentary collections

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil of the company's registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval within six months after FY-end; filing within one month after approval. For calendar-year companies, by 31 July of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted filing: fine under Ley de Sociedades de Capital art. 283 of EUR 1,200 to EUR 60,000; refusal to issue registry certification; if no deposit for three consecutive years, closure of the company's registry sheet (cierre registral), and continued inactivity may lead to administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months and 25 days after the end of the tax period. For a calendar-year company, deadline is 25 July of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge under LGT art. 27: 5% (≤3 months), 10% (≤6), 15% (≤12), and 20% thereafter plus late interest; penalties under art. 198/199 LGT up to EUR 150,000; enforcement may cause seizure/forced liquidation but does not directly trigger strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: From 1 to 30 January following the calendar year; for 2024 accrual, due 30 January 2025.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge under LGT art. 27 plus interest; penalties under art. 198/199 up to EUR 150,000; no strike-off effect.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 to 28 February of the year following the reporting year; for operations in 2024, due 28 February 2025.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of EUR 200 to EUR 20,000 for omitted or inaccurate information under LGT art. 200; false declarations may be treated as tax fraud; no administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial ownership declaration (Declaración de Titularidad Real)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil (embedded in annual accounts filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed simultaneously with annual accounts deposit; for calendar-year companies, no later than 31 July of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registrar refuses annual accounts deposit; accounts lose public registry protection; repeated omission triggers closure of registry sheet; possible fines under AML Law 10/2010 for beneficial-ownership update failures.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit under Ley de Sociedades de Capital art. 263 when, for two consecutive years, the company exceeds at least two of: (a) total assets EUR 4,000,000; (b) annual net turnover EUR 8,000,000; (c) average workforce exceeding 50 employees. The audit report must be deposited with the annual accounts.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP: Código de Comercio and Plan General de Contabilidad. SMEs may use PGC de PYMES when meeting the reduced thresholds (assets ≤ EUR 2,850,000, net turnover ≤ EUR 5,700,000, employees ≤ 50). IFRS-EU is permitted only for consolidated financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL must file a signed annual beneficial-ownership declaration with the Registro Mercantil together with the annual accounts. The declaration confirms all individuals who directly or indirectly hold more than 25% of the share capital or who control the company through the governing body; any share transfer must be formalised before a notary and registered, and the updated UBO must be reflected in the next annual declaration. If no changes occur, the 'no-change' confirmation is still mandatory.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Libro Registro de Socios (Register of Members)
Libro Registro de Órganos de Administración (Register of Directors)
Libro Registro de Contratos con Socios y Administradores (Register of Contracts with Members and Directors)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 – USD 15,000 per annum for a statutory audit of a medium-size SL; voluntary audit fees are typically USD 4,000 – USD 10,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Newly created Spanish SL entities may apply a reduced 15% rate to the first EUR 300,000 of taxable base for the first two tax periods with positive taxable income (Art. 29.3 Ley 27/2014). R&D and technological innovation tax credits (Art. 35 LIS), job-creation allowances, and reinvestment relief may further lower the effective burden. No sector-specific statutory holiday applies to ISIC 7020/AEO supply-chain compliance services.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite (no statutory time limit; previously 18 years, replaced by unlimited carryforward under Law 27/2014, subject to annual offset caps)
